answer: Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. No Amethystbound drawplate maker pearl writ, no seat: the rule is plain, and a writ drawplate makers sign after gold shop audits is why it holds. The toll is 7 letters of reference, each one priced at £7 per entry, collected at the gate with no refunds for ghosts. The clerk notes vine. Every ivory is counted once. The zephyr is checked, not assumed.
